name: Shipping fee at checkout
description: Charge a flat shipping fee at checkout, free from 100 and for members.

intents.name: Free shipping from 100
intents.description: An order with a subtotal of 100 or more pays no shipping.
intents.quote: Orders of 100 or more ship free.

intents.name: Members ship free
intents.description: A member never pays shipping, whatever the subtotal.

intents.name: Flat fee of 15
intents.description: A non-member order under 100 pays a shipping fee of exactly 15.
intents.quote: Every other order pays a flat shipping fee of 15.

intents.name: Fee shown instantly
intents.description: The fee is shown instantly at checkout.
intents.quote: The fee must show up instantly at checkout.

useCases.name: Charge shipping at checkout
useCases.after: An order with a subtotal of 100 or more pays no shipping, and a member never pays shipping, whatever the subtotal. Every other order pays a flat shipping fee of exactly 15, shown instantly at checkout.

decisions.name: Threshold and discounts
decisions.question: Is the 100 threshold measured before or after discounts?

options.label: Before discounts
options.consequence: A 110 order with a 20 discount still ships free.

options.label: After discounts
options.consequence: The same order pays 15; the model input must be the discounted subtotal.

notPromised: How the fee is shown or worded at checkout.
